estimate.damage_summary: An atmospheric overvoltage damaged a speaker system and a TV in the dwelling. A technician subsequently checked the surge failure and wiring safety.
estimate.policy_notes: The electronics are subject to the EUR 5,000 including VAT aggregate appliance sub-limit and the policy's no-improvement rule. Because no surge-protection device was used, indemnity for the damaged appliances is halved. Delivery and putting replacement equipment into service are not indemnifiable; service-arrangement charges are excluded.

lines.invoice_text: Surge-damaged home electronics (speaker system and TV set)
lines.rationale: Both appliances are described as physically damaged by the covered overvoltage event, and the quantity matches the TV and speaker system. The policy pays for standard-grade new equivalents, subject to the appliance sub-limit and the 50% reduction for the missing surge protection.

lines.invoice_text: Diagnostic surge-failure report and technician call-out
lines.rationale: The attendance plausibly relates to confirming the reported surge damage and checking wiring safety, but diagnosis itself is not clearly a repair cost; the policy also excludes attendance associated with a non-indemnifiable service arrangement. At most one attendance is plausible, and any accepted charge would be modest.
